segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Lauren. I wanted to confirm the scope we discussed: 48 seats for the operations team, plus 6 manager seats with reporting, targeting a June 3 go-live. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add two more managers in Q3, but for the initial order it's 54 total. I just need the quote to match that exactly for procurement.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, understood. I have 48 standard seats at $72 per seat per month and 6 manager seats at $115. With the annual prepay discount, the total comes to $44,064 for the first year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And implementation was separate, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. One-time implementation is $6,500. That includes the kickoff, data import, admin training, and two workflow sessions. If we need a third workflow session, that's $900, but I don't think we'll need it based on what you showed me.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Makes sense. Can you set payment terms to net 30? Our finance team won't approve due on receipt.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 30 is fine. I'll mark that in the billing tool and make sure the order form says annual subscription prepaid, implementation invoiced at signature, both net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. We also need the contract to start May 20 even if go-live is June 3, because IT wants access for setup.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. Start date May 20, initial term through May 19 next year. I'll include the sandbox access and admin credentials in the onboarding checklist after signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form today if you can. I'll route it to legal and procurement, and assuming no redlines, we can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it by 2 pm with the pricing summary attached and copy your finance alias for the invoice details.
